source_text: Si eum postulasset Petrus, forsitan amotis ancillis non denegasset. Nec enim poterat fieri ut facta interrogatione confiteretur Dominum in Spiritu sancto, cum Spiritus sanctus nondum fuisset datus. Audax promissio facta est ei causa ut non solum scandalizaretur verum etiam ter denegaret.
pass_a_gloss: If him had-asked Peter, perhaps with-removed servant-girls not he-would-have-denied. For not was-able to-happen that with-made interrogation he-would-confess the Lord in Spirit holy, when Spirit holy not-yet had-been given. Bold promise made was to-him cause that not only he-would-be-scandalized but-also thrice he-would-deny.
pass_b_english: If Peter had asked for that grace, perhaps — with the servant-girls and outer attendants removed — he would not have denied. For he could not yet confess the Lord [[in the Holy Spirit >> Bible:1 Corinthians 12:3]] when the Spirit had not yet been given. His bold promise became the occasion that he not only stumbled but [[denied three times >> Bible:Matthew 26:34]].
notes: Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
